# pve_vm_agent_info (Data Source)

Merged runtime facts of a QEMU guest as reported by its guest agent (`GET /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/agent/{info,get-host-name,get-osinfo,get-time,get-timezone,get-vcpus,get-users,network-get-interfaces}`). The QEMU guest agent must be installed and running inside the guest; facts whose command the installed agent does not answer are null. Only the pin's GET agent commands are used.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires the QEMU guest agent inside vm 100.
data "pve_vm_agent_info" "vm100" {
  node = "pve1"
  vmid = 100
}

output "guest_hostname" {
  value = data.pve_vm_agent_info.vm100.hostname
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node running the guest.
- `vmid` (Number) The ID of the guest (VM) to query.

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) Host name reported by the guest (`get-host-name`).
- `id` (String) Identifier of this data source (`node:vmid`).
- `interfaces` (Attributes List) Guest network interfaces from `network-get-interfaces`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `os_home_url` (String) Operating system home page from `get-osinfo`.
- `os_id` (String) Operating system identifier from `get-osinfo`, e.g. `ubuntu`.
- `os_id_like` (String) Operating systems this one resembles (`get-osinfo` `id_like`), e.g. `debian`.
- `os_kernel_name` (String) Kernel name from `get-osinfo`, e.g. `Linux`.
- `os_kernel_release` (String) Kernel release from `get-osinfo`, e.g. `5.15.0-91-generic`.
- `os_kernel_version` (String) Kernel build version from `get-osinfo`.
- `os_machine` (String) Machine architecture from `get-osinfo`, e.g. `x86_64`.
- `os_name` (String) Operating system name from `get-osinfo`, e.g. `Ubuntu`.
- `os_pretty_name` (String) Pretty operating system name from `get-osinfo`, e.g. `Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS`.
- `os_variant` (String) Operating system variant from `get-osinfo`, e.g. `server`.
- `os_variant_id` (String) Variant identifier from `get-osinfo`, e.g. `server`.
- `os_version` (String) Operating system version from `get-osinfo`.
- `os_version_id` (String) Operating system version identifier from `get-osinfo`, e.g. `22.04`.
- `time` (Number) Guest clock from `get-time` (agent-reported timestamp; the raw value is nanoseconds since the epoch on modern agents).
- `timezone` (String) Guest time zone from `get-timezone`, e.g. `Europe/Berlin`.
- `users` (List of String) User names of logged-in users reported by `get-users`.
- `vcpus` (Number) Number of vCPU entries reported by `get-vcpus`.
- `version` (String) Guest agent version from the `info` command.

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `hardware_address` (String) MAC address of the interface, e.g. `52:54:00:aa:bb:cc`.
- `ip_addresses` (Attributes List) Addresses assigned to this interface. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces--ip_addresses))
- `name` (String) Interface name inside the guest, e.g. `eth0`.

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces--ip_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces.ip_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) The IP address, e.g. `192.168.1.10`.
- `prefix` (Number) Network prefix length of the address.
- `type` (String) Address family reported by the agent: `ipv4` or `ipv6`.
